Name: SVE Susan Seasonal Anime Outfits
Author: DonutSteelPeas
Description:
Being honest I never had much interest in Susan from SVE until I saw BunBunz amazing anime interpretation for the character making her feel more unique to me. Afterward I decided to use the Seasonal Portraits mod on top of it and realized in order for my game to be cohesive I'd have to work on providing Seasonal anime variants myself and not many other people had yet, so here's my Susan! I'm by no means an artist so hopefully you can overlook my work if it's shoddy, just wanted to make something satisfactory to me and hope you'll enjoy it as well!

Deserved Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/185039619]bunzbunzMODS[/url] for the Base Portrait used, please check out their mod at:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17516](SVE) Anime Portraits Replacer at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]
P.S. If you're not okay with this release please dm me and I'll take it down ASAP!

How to Install:
First install: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]
Next: Simply just replace the folder containing Claire's Portrait's with my own! (If on vortex you must empty Susan's folder on Seasonal Outfits - Slight Cuter Aesthetic for SVE out, DEPLOY, then put portraits in, REDEPLOY)

Downloads.Description: Take these files and move them into Seasonal Outfits for SVE's assets -> Potraits -> Susan, replacing the portraits originally from there.
